prediction_protocol: CaM family held out, family_fold1; no fold0 training-member prediction or old record-split fold4 prediction used
anchor_definition: W303 to M316 inclusive, 14 residues, chosen by structural double anchors before consulting prediction/MD errors

structural_SASA.method: MDTraj Shrake-Rupley, heavy atoms, probe radius 1.4 Angstrom, 960 sphere points, identical coordinates with vs without CaM
structural_SASA.floating_point_note: Atom areas accumulated in float64; deletion differences that are mathematically zero remain exactly zero for exposed residues.

contacts.method: all heavy-atom minimum distances and 4.0 Angstrom contact cutoff; all 25 by 144 residue distances exported
contacts.CA8: record source CA<=8 Angstrom preserved only as approximate graph-neighborhood indicator; absence is not absence of atom-level contact

model_context_comparison: Full and Intra are alternative models on the bound complex target; Intra is not a true apo trajectory and differences do not measure a binding-induced change
supported: Bound peptide 303-316 anchor-spanning region has lower mean backbone RMSF and sidechain Hchi than the remaining 11 residues
Full recovers whole-peptide bound-state RMSF and Hchi more accurately than Intra in this held-out family
Static structural environment distinguishes same-type N297/N308 and anchors, but all recurring AA groups are exported for audit
unsupported: No direct apo-to-holo dynamics transition, no activation free energy, no proof of N-lobe causal requirement from static SASA/model alone
Lower Hchi does not directly measure rotation speed or intrinsic continuous angular width
Cross-amino-acid Hchi magnitudes cannot be interpreted solely as environment effects because chi counts differ

structure_preprocessing.caution: Processed model coordinates contain protein only; model outputs and static SASA are not a measurement of calcium effects.

static_SASA_point_density_sensitivity: All 25 residues checked again at 2880 points; separate CSV provided. Main quoted values use 960 points.
